1956 Lakenheath-Bentwaters UFO incident

#ufo #ufotwitter

It occurred over RAF Lakenheath and nearby Bentwaters in Suffolk, England in 1956. It is one of the most famous UFO cases involving independent radar detections (from both ground radars and airborne radar on a USAF C-47 and a Venom fighter), visual sightings by ground personnel and pilots, and attempted intercepts.

Key Event in the Document

📅 Date: 13–14 August 1956
📍 Location: RAF Bentwaters and RAF Lakenheath, England
👀 Witnesses:
U.S. Air Force radar operators
RAF radar operators

Fighter jet pilots

Ground observers

A C-47 transport aircraft crew

The document calls it one of the most significant radar-visual UFO cases because multiple independent sensors and witnesses detected the same object.

Timeline of the Incident

1️⃣ First radar detection

Bentwaters radar detects an unidentified radar echo (URE).

Estimated speed: ~4,000 mph.

Object disappears from radar after crossing the screen.

2️⃣ Group of objects appears

Shortly afterward:

12–15 radar targets appear together.

They move 80–125 mph as a group.

Eventually merge into one large radar return stronger than a large aircraft.

This single target then:

Stops in the air for 10–15 minutes

Moves again

Leaves radar coverage.

3️⃣ Extremely fast object

Another radar target:

Detected moving over 4,000 mph

Some calculations suggested up to ~12,000 mph.

4️⃣ Visual sightings

Several witnesses saw a bright light moving extremely fast.

Examples:

Control tower at Bentwaters saw a bright object flying east to west.

A C-47 aircraft pilot saw a bright light streak under his plane.

5️⃣ Fighter jet interception

A de Havilland Venom night fighter was scrambled.

The pilot:

Locked his radar guns on the object.

Said it was “the clearest target I have ever seen on radar.”

Then something strange happened:

The object suddenly moved behind the jet.

The pilot tried evasive maneuvers.

The UFO followed him for several minutes.

The pilot reportedly sounded frightened and returned to base.

Strange Behavior Observed

The object reportedly showed:

Instant acceleration

Sudden stops

Sharp turns

Speeds from stationary to thousands of mph

Ability to follow a jet from behind

These characteristics did not match known aircraft.

Possible Explanations Considered

The report discusses several hypotheses:

1️⃣ Meteor

Rejected because:

Objects changed direction

Stayed stationary

Appeared on radar for long periods.

2️⃣ Radar malfunction

Considered unlikely because:

Multiple independent radar systems detected it

Airborne radar from the fighter also detected it.

3️⃣ Atmospheric effects (anomalous propagation)

Possible for some radar returns, but could not explain the whole event.

Final Conclusion in the Document

The report concludes the case is unexplained and noteworthy:

Multiple radars

Visual witnesses

Fighter jet interception

Because of this, the incident is one of the most significant radar-visual UFO cases on record.
